description_en: Changes the specifications, storage type, and storage capacity of an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance that runs RDS Cluster Edition
description_zh: 该接口用于变更RDS MySQL集群系列实例节点的规格、存储类型、存储空间
name: ModifyDBNode

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the instance. Valid values:

cloud_essd: performance level 1 (PL1) enhanced SSD (ESSD)
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
parameters.help_zh:
实例储存类型，取值：
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type

parameters.help_en: The new storage capacity of the instance. Unit: GB For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.help_zh: 新实例存储容量。单位：GB。详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

fields.help_en: The specification information about the node
fields.name: class_code

parameters.help_en:
The information about the node.

This parameter is used for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances that run RDS Cluster Edition
parameters.help_zh:
节点相关信息。
该参数用于MySQL集群系列实例
parameters.name: db_node

parameters.help_en:
The time when you want the change to take effect. Valid values:

Immediate (default): The change immediately takes effect.
MaintainTime: The effective time is within the maintenance window. For more information, see ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime
parameters.help_zh:
生效时间，取值：
Immediate（默认值）：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在可运维时间段内生效，请参见ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically complete the payment. Valid values:

true: automatically completes the payment. Make sure that your account balance is sufficient.
false: does not automatically complete the payment. An unpaid order is generated.

The default value is true. If your account balance is insufficient, you can set the AutoPay parameter to false to generate an unpaid order. Then, you can log on to the ApsaraDB RDS console to pay for the order
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付。
取值范围：

true：自动支付。您需要确保账户余额充足。

false：只生成订单不扣费。




默认值为true。如果您的支付方式余额不足，可以将参数AutoPay设置为false，此时会生成未支付订单，您可以登录RDS管理控制台自行支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values: Valid values:

true: performs a dry run and does not perform the actual request. The system checks items such as the request parameters, request format, service limits, and available resources.
false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次节点变更的操作执行预检查。取值范围：
true：执行预检查操作，不执行变更。检查项目包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。
false：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行变更（默认）
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to asynchronously perform the operation. Valid values:

true (default): sends only the order. The operation is asynchronously performed.
false: sends the request. After the request passes the check, the operation is directly performed.

The default value is true, which indicates that the change operation is asynchronously performed. If you set this parameter to false, the change operation is simultaneously performed. This prolongs the response time of the operation
parameters.help_zh:
是否异步执行生产。取值范围：
true：请求只下发订单，变更操作会异步执行（默认）。
false：请求下发的同时，通过检查后直接执行变更。

默认值为true，变更操作异步执行。如果设置为false，变更操作同步执行，接口响应时间会相对较长
parameters.name: produce_async

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
表示请求是否成功，各取值含义如下：

true：成功
false：失败
